The '''Artham''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the form of a dull dagger that hides its bearer from [[Shadowspawn]] and the Shadow in general.  It was created after [[Lews Therin Telamon|Lews Therin]]'s death and was eventually recovered from the [[Kin's Store Room]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

[[Aviendha]] discovered her talent of [[Reading ter'angreal|Reading ''ter'angreal'']] by examining the dull dagger.

== Appearance ==
The dagger is slightly longer than the palm of a hand, but wide in proportion. It is seemingly made of iron, but appears to also have never been sharpened, with an edge that would not cut much more than butter. The hilt is made of rough deerhorn and wrapped in gold wire.

== Use ==
Whoever is in possession of the dagger becomes invisible to [[Shadowspawn]], including [[Myrddraal]] and [[Trollocs]]. Aviendha also states that it is possible that even the [[Dark One]] himself may not be able to see its wielder.{{ref/book|11|15}}

== Role ==
The dagger was given to [[Rand al'Thor]] by [[Elayne Trakand]] shortly before the [[Last Battle]] to hide him from the eyes of the [[Dark One]] until their very confrontation. He refers to it as '''Artham''' and says that attempts to create similar ''ter'angreal'' were made during the [[Age of Legends]], but were unsuccessful, and wonders who finally managed it.{{ref/book|14|20}}

==Parallels==
The name is taken from a ritual dagger used in Wiccan and other traditions called [[wikipedia:athame|athame]]. It is also spelled '''arthame''', if less often. It is one of the four tools used by a magician and is strictly not used for cutting, hence the blunted blade in the books, and is normally made from iron.
